responsibility: Implements the VAX backend’s C target hooks and hand-written RTL support routines that complement the declarative patterns in vax.md. This file initializes VAX-specific target behavior such as option overrides for non-IEEE floating formats, address legitimacy and addressing-cost logic, RTX cost modeling, CC-mode compatibility, asm-statement flag clobber adjustment, calling-convention hooks for argument passing and structure returns, prologue generation and frame layout helpers, libfunc setup, thunk emission, and nested-function trampoline construction/initialization. It also contains target-side expansion/output helpers for operations that need procedural RTL generation rather than pure machine-description patterns, making it the main implementation file for VAX ABI, frame, cost, and hook semantics.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name VAX files, this is the executable backend implementation file that wires VAX target hooks into targetm and provides procedural logic for ABI/frame handling, address and cost calculations, thunk/trampoline emission, and helper expansions that machine-description rules alone cannot express. It differs from vax.h’s macro/configuration interface, vax.md’s declarative RTL instruction patterns, and vax.opt’s option declarations.
